intent: 处理前后对比，批准不等于保存。

Noninteractive bullet check guidance "细节是否清晰" / "颜色是否自然" / "是否有多余纹理". Primary "通过增强结果", secondary "驳回增强结果". NO colleague correction offered here, it belongs only to background-removal review. No save. Footer "通过后选择是否去除背景。".
